reference_battery.state_scopes: full owner including actual nonlinear field, carrier and heterogeneous material; maximum over every production step

protocol.bootstrap_empty_policy_note: Original-world resampling retains the fixed eligible mask. Any empty eligible resample makes the interval undefined and the endpoint INCONCLUSIVE. No draws are dropped or redrawn. At 10 eligible of 40 and 100000 resamples, expected empty draws are about 1.006 and chance of at least one is about 63.4%; the ten-world minimum is necessary, not sufficient for a defined interval.
protocol.development_binding_policy: Experiment-producing code, readiness/analysis, protocol, native/build, support tools, source pins, environment and milestone configuration. Tests and mutants are bound by the final milestone fingerprint, not the development receipt.
protocol.response_descriptor_scope: Every reached source-operation prefix B_before and all B_after branches, even after physical source loss; unqualified R0 prefix has an explicit no-treatment response. Candidate qualification snapshots are retained in full; their response assay is scheduled only if they become a reached operation source.
